apvts_integration.details: createParameterLayout() present and complete: all 42 params from parameter-spec.md present -- 29 float (swing, humanize, quantizeStrength, tempo, outputLevel + per-voice Tune/Decay/Tone/Level x6 = 24), 1 choice (patternLength with StringArray {8,16,32}, default idx 1 = 16), 12 bool (per-voice Mute/Solo x6). Ranges match: unitRange 0-1, dbRange -60..0, Tune -12..+12, tempo 40-240. Param IDs are composed from BeatmakerIDs::ParamIDs + voiceParamID(), the single source of truth -- no literal drift. APVTS member 'parameters' declared (PluginProcessor.h:122) and constructed with createParameterLayout() (PluginProcessor.cpp:102). app.js param IDs cross-checked: GLOBAL_SLIDERS, VOICE_SLIDER_SUFFIX, COMBO_IDS=[patternLength], TOGGLE_IDS, and VOICES prefixes (kick/snare/clap/closedHat/openHat/tom) all map 1:1 to layout params -- ZERO app.js IDs absent from the layout, no dead controls. PluginEditor builds its relay/attachment ID lists from the same BeatmakerIDs source, so editor<->layout match by construction; jassert(param) guards each attachment. Native-fn parity holds: app.js getNativeFunction(setStep/getGrid/clearGrid/getSampleRate) all registered via withNativeFunction in PluginEditor.cpp.
